text_block_list.text:
The day of the 1st Live has finally 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Yes, then just like the rehearsal 
earlier. It's fine with no extra smoke at 
the end. Understood.

Light Hello is giving final instructions 
to the on-site staff. Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaaale... exhaaaale... 
Inhhhhaaaallle... exhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All that's left is to sing for 
everyone on stage! I've done everything I 
needed to for today, after all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Even yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm having a concert soon! Please come 
watch, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning, Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Bourbon-chan! You've gotta come 
see our next live show, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Without fail. By that, do you mean it is 
an order?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Here's Falco's super special 
order☆ Take good care of it, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Order received.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to call out to so many of the 
girls right until the end! So this time, 
for sure...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The song that everyone prepared for me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I truly want to reach someone's heart.

...Smart Falcon's lips looked as though 
they were trembling just a little.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Falco can do this! I'll get 
everyone hyped up and make them want to 
help out—
choice_data_list:
You don't have to hype things up all on 
your own.

You don't have to hype things up all on 
your own, you know.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...

Having fellow performers isn't limited to 
just on the stage.

In the wings of the stage stand the girls, 
and in front of the stage are the 
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. After all, this live is meant 
to ask for everyone's cooperation."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna ask everyone a bunch to 
"have fun together"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... First, let us observe. What you 
will bring about in this Winning Live, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: “...And, Suzuka-kun? Suzuukaa-kuun!”

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...You don't have to call out so loudly. 
I'm right here."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Prickly as ever, aren't you? Well, don't 
you dare look away from what's about to 
happen, alright?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even a faint electrical stimulus can 
activate the brain. Will that stimulus 
lead to the desired response?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Does the piece we need even exist? First 
of all, we have to verify that.
